candidate_scope: baseline source plus selected codec.rs and common performance example; final codec/example/unchanged envelope_cost hashes match production working tree
selection: linear stable seed selection and normalized seed union before materialization; original 64 KiB stack scratch retained

algorithm.before: clone initial recipe-cost pairs; sort two full domains; materialize legacy and augmented refinements; scan growing output with contains for every augmented recipe
algorithm.after: stable linear scan retains the two lowest (cost, declaration index) family minima; at most four seed identities are compared before one output materialization
algorithm.identity: family is format+x86; seed union erases only mf and nice_len because expansion overwrites exactly those fields; all other typed Recipe fields remain identity
algorithm.ordering: legacy seed order first, then previously absent augmented seed order; output mf/nice_len order unchanged
algorithm.complexity: O(n + r) planning work instead of O(n log n + r^2) worst-case sort/expanded-union work; n is initial recipes and r is materialized recipes
algorithm.memory: removes full initial Recipe clones and a second expanded-domain temporary; bounded seed references plus one required owned output domain; no process-RSS reduction claimed
algorithm.preserved: all declared recipes, requested coverage, ordered ties/errors, full typed cache identity, worker lifecycle/limits, codec parameters, restoration checks, fresh regeneration

environment.rss_scope: wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB for complete process including representative reports/fresh checks and inherited launcher footprint

quiet_window: root and other agents paused CPU-heavy work for selected matrix; shared host remains uncontrolled

cold_case_scope.small: 24 distinct 16 KiB generated base payloads plus pass comments; eight fixed recipes; codec cache disabled, header cache retained; jobs1 and4
cold_case_scope.legacy: three distinct 8 KiB generated base payloads plus pass comments; normal legacy initial+adaptive refinement domain; codec cache disabled, header cache retained; jobs4
cold_case_scope.file: 24 complete cost measurements of exact retained bytes; eight fixed recipes; codec cache disabled, header cache retained; jobs4
cold_case_scope.mixed: 512 KiB generated payload; bzip2 and gzip levels1..9; three complete measurements; all caches disabled; jobs1 and4
cold_case_scope.restore: 8 MiB repeated x; gzip levels1..4; one complete measurement; all caches disabled; jobs4

cold_case_scope.fixed_recipes: gzip1/9,bzip2_1/9,alone6,xz6,raw6,raw6+x86; LZMA dict_size from base payload length capped8MiB; same domain in both versions

identity_checks.all_versions_match: input length/hash, timed minimum-cost vector hashes, representative complete recipe-result vectors (typed recipe/full-file length/artifact hash), representative winning artifact length/hash; planning initial/refinement vector hashes
identity_checks.fresh: every one of 88 cost processes freshly regenerates its representative complete portfolio and compares all representative recipe records and winning artifact bytes
identity_checks.limits: timed unique payload vectors preserve every minimum cost, not every intermediate encoded stream; all timed codecs restore exact input in their own run, but cross-version per-recipe hashes cover the later representative base payload only; legacy representative base has its own length-selected dictionary

interpretation: Planning-only speedup is not a whole source-search, compression campaign or engine speedup.
Normal legacy cost shows observed median improvement, while codec time dominates and the four-trial shared-host ranges overlap.
Fixed portfolios do not run adaptive refinement. Their timing/RSS changes are retained controls, not benefits attributed to this selected algorithm.
Tiny and ice4 medians are slower in the selected matrix; no broad speed guarantee is made.
RSS includes inherited launcher footprint and is insensitive to many small planning allocations; no new process-memory reduction is claimed.
Prior indexed FIFO cache/streaming verification/bounded worker-window behavior is preserved; no new cache or concurrency policy is claimed.
